searchText: When I open https://faucet.rinkeby.io/, it show "Faucet offline". Is there something wrong with the website? Or is it my personal problem? It works, I just got 1 ether. Thanks. Do you have any advice? thanks Has everyone already turned off their Pyrmont validators? Is it safe for the EF to turn theirs off as well or are there still scenario's people want to see? Dunno who is/isn't using pyrmont, but my node is fully connected with 128 peers so there are quite a few nodes out there still operating. thanks! I guess i'll leave them running for now Probably unrelated, but looks like prater just dropped down to sub-80% participation. Back again; probably just someone rebooting a node.
